hypotheses.H1: unweighted prior changes effective spectral regularization
hypotheses.H2: quadrature discretization stabilizes total prior and some sensor covariance properties
hypotheses.H3: prior and regularization explain part, not necessarily all, of localization nonmonotonicity
hypotheses.H4: effects interact with method/noise/geometry; negative findings valid

source_design.split_unit: source; no source appears in both partitions

grids.domain: ball radius 0.065 m, same domain for all grids
grids.quadrature: 65536 unscrambled Sobol uniform-volume ball probes; nearest-site Voronoi mass; explicit approximate cell volumes

assumed_covariance: (5e-8 V)^2 average-reference projector for every noise condition; exact retained-subspace whitening

regularization.spectral: alpha/maximum eigenvalue of whitened prior lead covariance fixed at method historical numerical constant
regularization.prediction: choose sweep minimum independent-repeat sensor MSE using calibration sources 0..5 only; no test locations or errors

forward.primary: standard level2 Gmsh FEM candidates; finest level3 Gmsh FEM truth
forward.truth_new: independent off-grid seeds; shared full-subtraction formulation remains correlated
forward.BEM: OpenMEEG2.6.0 level2; same finest FEM truth and measurement vectors
forward.reuse: public archived original M30 physical fields with byte hashes; new fields freshly solved, no candidate operator as truth

uncertainty.method: fixed-family-stratified heads then sources within heads; noise averaged first; paired contrasts retain indices
uncertainty.scope: conditional six-generator simulation, uncalibrated coverage, no participant/population inference

acceptance.historical_gate_policy: unchanged; post-merge native signature drift BLOCK_RELEASE
acceptance.hypothesis_decisions: report estimates and conditional intervals; H2 volume/total prior trace invariant to 1e-12, sensor covariance relative drift and localization contrasts reported without forcing success

budget.failures: retain every planned configuration failure; do not choose alternative settings after outcomes

limitations: local seal is not external preregistration
same six synthetic heads, not human anatomical validation
grid-union refinement adds sites and changes Voronoi cells, not an exact nested FEM basis
white-source density is a generalized random field, not pointwise finite variance smooth current
native Gmsh portability remains unestablished and changed signature blocks release
